ticket.title: fix(login-app): Login Location tag filter silently ignored in useLocationCount
ticket.text:
fix(login-app): Login Location tag filter silently ignored in useLocationCount

## Problem

In `location-picker.resource.ts`, the `useLocationCount` hook used
`url.concat('&_tag=Login Location')` to apply the FHIR tag filter
when `useLoginLocationTag` was enabled.

However, `String.prototype.concat()` returns a new string without
mutating the original variable — so the tag filter was never actually
applied, regardless of the config value.

## Impact

Hospitals that configured `chooseLocation.useLoginLocationTag: true`
to restrict login locations were unknowingly receiving ALL locations
from the server. This caused `locationCount` to return the total number
of all locations rather than only tagged ones, breaking the auto-redirect
logic that skips the location picker when only one valid location exists.

## Fix

- Replaced `url.concat()` with `URLSearchParams` to correctly build
  and encode the query string
- Corrected FHIR parameter name from `tag=` to `_tag=`
- Added unit tests for `useLocationCount` covering URL construction
  for both flag values

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Configure `chooseLocation.useLoginLocationTag: true`
2. Have only one location tagged as "Login Location"
3. Observe that the location picker is NOT skipped (broken auto-redirect)

## PR

[link removed]

understanding.intent: Ensure that the login location count properly filters by the 'Login Location' tag so that the location picker is automatically skipped when only one tagged location exists.

criteria.text: When chooseLocation.useLoginLocationTag is enabled and only one location is tagged as 'Login Location', the login process skips the location picker via auto-redirect.
criteria.quote: skips the location picker when only one valid location exists

criteria.text: When chooseLocation.useLoginLocationTag is enabled and multiple locations are tagged as 'Login Location', the location picker is displayed.

understanding.domain_reason: Applies to the core login flow and location picker in OpenMRS 3.
